metadata.title: DGFT Statutory Export Incentive Schedules & RoDTEP / RoSCTL Master
metadata.authority: Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India

latest_notifications.title: Public Notice No. 05/2024-DGFT
latest_notifications.subject: Extension of RoDTEP Scheme for exports made from DTA and SEZ/EOU units
latest_notifications.details: RoDTEP benefits extended across 10,610 ITC(HS) tariff lines till 30th September 2025 with statutory budget allocation.

latest_notifications.title: Ministry of Textiles & DGFT RoSCTL Gazette
latest_notifications.subject: Continuation of Rebate of State and Central Taxes and Levies (RoSCTL) for Apparel/Made-ups
latest_notifications.details: Rebate rates up to 4.3% applicable for Chapters 61 and 62, and up to 3.2% for Chapter 63 (Home Textiles).

latest_notifications.title: Trade Notice No. 12/2024-DGFT
latest_notifications.subject: Electronic Duty Credit Scrip Transferability & Ledger Management
latest_notifications.details: Clarifies that RoDTEP/RoSCTL scrips can be freely transferred electronically on ICEGATE to any importer for payment of Basic Customs Duty (BCD).

RoDTEP.name: Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products
RoDTEP.legal_basis: Foreign Trade Policy 2023, Chapter 4; Section 50 of Customs Act, 1962
RoDTEP.eligible_taxes: Central excise on fuel for transport, electricity duty, mandi tax, stamp duty, embedded un-rebated VAT
RoDTEP.validity: 12 months from date of scrip generation in ICEGATE ledger

RoSCTL.name: Rebate of State and Central Taxes and Levies
RoSCTL.legal_basis: Ministry of Textiles Notification & DGFT FTP 2023
RoSCTL.eligible_taxes: State VAT on fuel, electricity duty, central excise on fuel, mandi charges
RoSCTL.validity: 12 months from date of scrip generation

Duty_Drawback.name: All Industry Rates of Duty Drawback (AIR DBK)
Duty_Drawback.legal_basis: Customs Act, 1962 (Section 75) & CBIC Annual Drawback Notification
Duty_Drawback.disbursement: Direct Rupee bank transfer to exporter's PFMS-verified bank account within 72 hours of EGM
Duty_Drawback.statutory_rate_basis: Reimbursement of customs duties paid on imported inputs and raw materials used in export manufacture

Interest_Equalization.name: Interest Equalization Scheme (IES) on Pre and Post Shipment Rupee Export Credit
Interest_Equalization.legal_basis: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) & DGFT Trade Policy Notification
Interest_Equalization.subvention_rate: 3.0% per annum for MSME Manufacturer Exporters; 2.0% for 410 notified HS lines
Interest_Equalization.disbursement: Direct interest deduction by commercial bank on export working capital packing credit (EPC/PCFC)
